CameraConfig.description:
The camera model a workflow calibrates, and which of its parameters stay
fixed.

The model names one kind per slot — projection, distortion and sensor —
so a tilted (Scheimpflug) sensor is a value of `model.sensor`, not a
separate workflow. Behaviour that depends on the sensor (default fix
lists, the linear stage's tangential terms, the tilt multi-start) follows
from the model.

fix.description:
Parameters held fixed during the non-linear solve, named per slot
(`{"intrinsics": ["cx", "cy"], "distortion": ["k3"], "sensor":
["tilt_y"]}`). A slot left out keeps the model's default: `k3` for
Brown-Conrady, and everything but the low-order radial terms (`k1`,
`k2`; the division model's `lambda`) under a Scheimpflug sensor,
because tangential and higher-order terms trade off against the tilt.
An unknown name is a configuration error.

model.description:
The camera model, one kind per slot. Default: pinhole projection,
Brown-Conrady (`k1, k2, k3, p1, p2`) distortion and an identity
(untilted) sensor — the model every workflow accepts.

CameraFix.description:
Camera parameters held fixed during a solve, named per slot.

Each list names parameters of the model in that slot (`fx`, `cy`, `k3`,
`tilt_y`, …). `None` means the model's default
([`CameraModelSpec::default_fix`]); an empty list fixes nothing in that
slot. Names are checked against the model by [`CameraFix::resolve`], before
any work.

distortion.description:
Fixed distortion coefficients; default: `k3` for Brown-Conrady, and
everything but the low-order radial terms under a Scheimpflug sensor.

CameraModelSpec.description:
A camera model: the kind in each slot. The values live in
[`CameraParams`](super::CameraParams); [`CameraParams::spec`](super::CameraParams::spec)
recovers the spec from them.

CameraOverride.description:
One camera of a rig whose model differs from the rig's `camera`, so a
rig can mix lenses (a tilted laser camera beside a frontal one, a fisheye
beside a narrow lens).

camera.description: Index of the camera in the rig (`0..num_cameras`).

fix.description:
Parameters held fixed during the non-linear solves, named per slot;
a slot left out keeps the model's default (see [`CameraConfig::fix`]).

model.description: The camera's model, one kind per slot.

DistortionKind.description:
Which distortion model a camera carries.

`dim() == 0` means the camera has no distortion parameter block.

oneOf.description: Rational polynomial `[k1, k2, k3, k4, k5, k6, p1, p2]`.
Brown-Conrady + thin-prism `[k1, k2, k3, p1, p2, s1, s2, s3, s4]`.

FxFyCxCy.description:
Standard pinhole intrinsics: focal lengths and principal point in pixels.

The pixel grid is assumed orthogonal, so `K` carries no skew term.

cx.description: Principal point X coordinate in pixels.

cy.description: Principal point Y coordinate in pixels.

fx.description: Focal length in pixels along X.

fy.description: Focal length in pixels along Y.

HandeyeInitConfig.description:
Hand-eye linear-initialization stage options (Tsai-Lenz DLT).

Shared by every hand-eye problem's `handeye_init` config group.

min_motion_angle_deg.description: Minimum motion angle (degrees) for linear hand-eye initialization.

HandeyeMode.description:
Hand-eye calibration mode.

Specifies the transform chain used for hand-eye calibration.

oneOf.description:
Camera mounted on robot end-effector (gripper).

Transform chain: P_camera = extr^-1 * handeye^-1 * robot^-1 * target * P_world

Camera fixed in workspace, observes robot end-effector.

Transform chain: P_camera = extr^-1 * handeye * robot * target * P_world

HandeyeOptimizeConfig.description:
Final hand-eye bundle-adjustment options; robot-pose refinement lives in
the shared [`RobotPoseConfig`] group.

refine_cam_se3_rig.description:
Refine cam_se3_rig in hand-eye BA (default: false).
When true, rig extrinsics are further refined during hand-eye optimization.

refine_sensor.description:
Refine the sensor tilt of each Scheimpflug camera in hand-eye BA,
holding its `fix.sensor` list (default: false). Cameras with an
untilted sensor have no tilt.

robot_poses.description: Robot-pose refinement settings for the final hand-eye BA.

IntrinsicsInitConfig.description:
Per-camera linear-initialization stage (Zhang's method + iterative
Brown-Conrady distortion fit).

Shared by every intrinsics-bearing problem's `init` config group.

fix_k3.description: Fix k3 during initialization (recommended for typical lenses).

fix_tangential.description:
Fix tangential distortion (p1, p2) during initialization.

`None` (the default) takes the camera's default: `true` for a
Scheimpflug sensor in planar intrinsics — the tilt/tangential
coupling makes a free tangential term ill-posed during the linear
stage — and `false` otherwise. The multi-camera workflows resolve
`None` to `false` for every camera, whatever its sensor: their
per-camera linear stage has always kept the tangential terms free.

iterations.description: Number of iterations for iterative intrinsics estimation.

IntrinsicsManualInit.description:
Manual seeds for the **per-camera intrinsics stage** of rig hand-eye
calibration. See `rig_extrinsics::IntrinsicsManualInit` for semantics.

`per_cam_sensors` seeds the tilt of each camera with a Scheimpflug sensor
(a seeded tilt skips the tilt sweep); a camera with an untilted sensor
takes only a zero tilt.

per_cam_intrinsics.description: Per-camera intrinsics seeds. `None` runs Zhang's method per camera.

per_cam_sensors.description:
Per-camera sensor tilt seeds (Scheimpflug cameras; zero for the
others).

ProjectionKind.description: Which projection model a camera uses.

oneOf.description: Pinhole (perspective) projection; no parameters of its own.

RigConfig.description:
Multi-camera rig frame options: reference-camera gauge and rig-BA scope.

The `rig` group of `RigExtrinsicsConfig` and `RigHandeyeConfig`.

reference_camera_idx.description: Reference camera index for the rig frame (identity extrinsics).

refine_intrinsics.description:
Re-refine per-camera intrinsics and distortion jointly during rig
bundle adjustment, holding the camera's `fix` lists. Default:
`false` — the per-camera solves have already fitted them.

refine_sensor.description:
Re-refine the sensor tilt of each Scheimpflug camera during rig
bundle adjustment, holding its `fix.sensor` list. Default: `false` —
the tilt is fitted per camera and trades off against the extrinsics
in the joint solve. Cameras with an untilted sensor have no tilt.

RobotPoseConfig.description:
Robot-pose refinement options for hand-eye bundle adjustment.

Shared by `SingleCamHandeyeConfig`, `HandeyeOptimizeConfig`, and the joint
rig+hand-eye+laser BA config (`JointOptimizeConfig`).

refine.description: Refine robot poses with per-view se(3) corrections.

RobustLoss.description:
Robust loss applied to a residual block.

Each residual block has its own loss; per-point robustification is achieved
by using one residual block per observation.

oneOf.description: Huber loss: quadratic up to `‖r‖ = scale`, linear beyond.

scale.description:
Transition residual norm, in residual units (pixels for
reprojection).

oneOf.description:
Cauchy loss: logarithmic growth, influence decreasing beyond
`‖r‖ ≈ scale`.

scale.description: Residual norm where down-weighting sets in, in residual units.

oneOf.description: Arctangent loss: bounded, influence vanishing for large residuals.

scale.description:
Transition in squared-residual units: down-weighting sets in near
`‖r‖ ≈ √scale`.

tilt_x.description: Tilt around X axis in radians (alias: tau_x).

tilt_y.description: Tilt around Y axis in radians (alias: tau_y).

SensorKind.description: Which sensor model a camera uses.

oneOf.description: Sensor plane perpendicular to the optical axis; no parameters.

SolverBackend.description:
Which engine linearizes the problem.

Both run the same Levenberg–Marquardt loop over the same residual
kernels and reach the same minimizer; they differ in how they build the
Jacobian and how they fold in a robust loss.

oneOf.description:
`tiny-solver`: dynamic-size forward-mode dual numbers; a robust loss
enters through the Triggs correction (second-order exact).

`factrs`: static-size forward-mode dual numbers; a robust loss enters
through iterative reweighting (each block scaled by `√ρ′`).

SolverConfig.description:
Non-linear solve stage options shared across problem types.

`max_iters` has no single workspace-wide default — problems override it
per solve-stage cost. Documented per-problem defaults: 50 standard; 120
for planar intrinsics (sized for a tilted sensor's tilt valley; the
solver stops at convergence, so the cap only bounds runs that do not
converge); 30 for a warm-started joint
rig+hand-eye+laser polish; 200 for the rig-laserline frozen-geometry
stage (cheap 1-DOF-per-view problem). This struct's own [`Default`] is
50 — the plain value used by problems with no reason to deviate.

backend.description:
Engine that linearizes the problem for the Levenberg–Marquardt loop.
Both reach the same minimizer; see [`SolverBackend`].

max_iters.description: Maximum iterations for the non-linear optimizer.

robust_loss.description: Robust loss function for outlier handling.

description:
Configuration for multi-camera rig hand-eye calibration.

Grouped by stage. Every camera has the model of `camera` unless
`camera_overrides` names it, so one rig can mix lenses and sensors.

The reference-camera gauge fix (`rig.reference_camera_idx`) alone removes
the full 6-DOF rig gauge; an extra per-view pose constraint would be
redundant and mildly pessimizing (as for `RigExtrinsicsConfig`).
View-0's rig-from-target pose is always free in the rig BA.

camera.description:
The camera model of every rig camera and the parameters its solves
hold fixed. A tilted (Scheimpflug) sensor's per-camera solve runs a
multi-start tilt sweep; seed its tilt through `manual_init`.

camera_overrides.description:
Cameras whose model differs from `camera`, at most one entry per
camera index.

intrinsics.description:
Per-camera linear-initialization stage settings. An unset
`fix_tangential` keeps the tangential terms free for every camera.

manual_init.description: Optional manual seeds for the per-camera intrinsics stage.

rig.description: Rig frame options (reference camera, rig-BA scope).
